chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Al-Mugheira, from Abu Jareer Al-Qummy, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) used to fulfill twenty Witr prayers in one night.
ai.seo_question: How many Witr prayers did the Imams perform at night?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the devotional intensity of Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (peace be upon him), who would perform twenty Witr prayers in a single night, illustrating the flexibility within Shia jurisprudence to offer multiple Witr prayers as distinct acts of worship rather than a single obligatory conclusion to night prayers. This practice underscores the virtue of prolonged night vigil (Qiyam al-Layl) and the Imam’s role as a model for spiritual discipline and extra devotion beyond the mandatory obligations.
